summary: Compare LNG cargo economics, SPA terms and market signals through practical case exercises. Explore the course and build commercial decision skills.
lede: LNG commercial training helps commercial, finance, contract and gas business professionals assess cargo economics and make SPA decisions. Learners use JKM and other market signals, compare pricing and netback scenarios in spreadsheets, and review FOB and DES delivery terms, take-or-pay exposure and destination flexibility. They also assess counterparty and delivery risks and coordinate inputs to prepare a cargo comparison and commercial recommendation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape LNG transactions, assess their economics or coordinate decisions across the gas value chain.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with energy-sector commercial, finance, contract or gas business development work is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use Excel-based calculations and case assumptions.
